title: Vibrant Malt Ethiopian Injera Flatbread
description: A malty, crunchy, light Ethiopian dish featuring salsa and salt-bake, perfect for snack time, this egg-free friendly flatbread is a delight to make and eat.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine teff flour, all purpose flour, malt powder, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add water to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let the mixture ferment in a warm place for 24 hours.
Preheat a non-stick skillet or injera pan over medium heat.
Using a ladle, pour a small amount of the batter onto the skillet and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook the injera for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Repeat the process until all the batter is used up.
Serve the injera warm with salsa spooned over the top.
Let the injera cool completely before storing in an airtight container.
